controls.title: Establish Governance Policies
controls.description: Establish AI risk management governance policies, including organizational roles and alignment with risk appetite.

controls.title: Map AI Context & Risks
controls.description: Map the AI system context, specify business goals, and categorize risks and potential negative impacts.

controls.title: Measure trustworthiness
controls.description: Measure AI system trustworthiness, bias, robustness, and accuracy against standards before and during deployment.

controls.title: Manage Operational Risks
controls.description: Manage risks of active systems, establish incident reporting pathways, and continuous validation pipelines.

controls.title: Risk Management System
controls.description: Establish and maintain a continuous risk management system for high-risk AI systems.

controls.title: Data Governance Controls
controls.description: Enforce training data quality control, checking for bias, representation, and target security vectors.

controls.title: Technical Documentation
controls.description: Draft and compile comprehensive technical documentation demonstrating conformity before system deployment.

controls.title: Automatic Logging & Auditing
controls.description: Enable automatic logging of system decisions, prompt/response telemetry, and lifecycle events.

controls.title: User Transparency Provisions
controls.description: Provide clear documentation on system behavior, scope, performance limitations, and intended use boundaries.

controls.title: Human Oversight Mechanisms
controls.description: Design systems to allow effective human oversight, including intervention and operational bypass switches.

controls.title: Accuracy, Robustness & Security
controls.description: Maintain high standards of accuracy, cybersecurity, and resistance to adversarial prompt inputs.

controls.title: AI Policy Alignment
controls.description: Draft, publish, and align organizational AI policies with overall business governance targets.

controls.title: Internal Roles Definition
controls.description: Define clear internal roles, responsibilities, and authorizations for AI system management.

controls.title: System Resources Audit
controls.description: Evaluate compute, dataset, human, and service resources required for the AI system lifecycle.

controls.title: Impact Assessment Workflow
controls.description: Design and document standardized templates for AI system impact assessments (DPIA / AIA).

controls.title: Automated Decision Protections
controls.description: Enforce safeguards against automated profiling and decisions without explicit human review mechanisms.

controls.title: DPIA Requirements
controls.description: Mandate and track Data Protection Impact Assessments for AI applications handling sensitive demographic information.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 6 — System Risk Tiering
obligations.description: Determine and record the system's risk classification (Prohibited, High, Limited, or Minimal Risk) prior to deployment.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 9 — Conformity Assessment
obligations.description: Conduct a formal conformity assessment for any designated High-Risk AI system.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 51 — EU DB Registration
obligations.description: Formally register the High-Risk AI system in the official EU database for AI systems.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 61 — Post-Market Monitoring
obligations.description: Design and operationalize a post-market monitoring plan to collect real-time behavior and performance statistics.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 14 — Human-In-The-Loop
obligations.description: Provide an active interface for humans to review and override automated decisions in high-stakes fields.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 52 — AI Interaction Disclosure
obligations.description: Disclose explicitly to end-users that they are interacting with an AI system, especially in natural language chat interfaces.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 13 — Model Cards & Intended Use
obligations.description: Document and publish standardized model capability cards outlining operational parameters and out-of-scope boundaries.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 10 — Dataset Bias Screening
obligations.description: Establish automated screening scripts to test training datasets for demographic bias, representation gaps, and toxic content.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 12 — Telemetry Auditing
obligations.description: Maintain persistent execution logs capturing prompt input, model metadata, latency, and full governance decision actions.

obligations.article_or_task: EU AI Act Art. 17 — Continuous Quality Management
obligations.description: Establish a structured quality management program including standard operating procedures and version control.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF GOV-1.2 — Define Authority Matrices
obligations.description: Formally define the roles, responsibilities, and authorization levels for all AI builders, risk managers, and auditors.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MAP-1.1 — Document Use-Cases
obligations.description: Document the intended business goals, operational environment, and specific problem the AI system aims to solve.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MAP-1.5 — Stakeholder Safeguards
obligations.description: Map and log potential negative impacts of AI outputs on customer civil rights, data privacy, and physical safety.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MEASURE-1.1 — Vendor Model Auditing
obligations.description: Conduct security and robustness evaluations on third-party foundational models (e.g. GPT-4, Claude) before integrations.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MEASURE-2.3 — Prompt Injection Threat Model
obligations.description: Run recurring red-teaming simulations evaluating model vulnerabilities to jailbreaks, prompt injections, and data extraction.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MANAGE-1.2 — Performance Drift Alerting
obligations.description: Configure automated monitors tracking model semantic shift and output distribution drift over time.

obligations.article_or_task: ISO 42001 A5 — AIMS Scope Definition
obligations.description: Establish and document the boundaries, limitations, and regulatory sphere of the AI Management System (AIMS).

obligations.article_or_task: ISO 42001 A6 — AI System Inventory
obligations.description: Build and maintain a central active registry of all models, microservices, and AI-enabled components in production.

obligations.article_or_task: ISO 42001 A8 — AI Risk Treatment Plan
obligations.description: Draft and review a structured risk treatment blueprint detailing immediate mitigating actions for high-risk operations.

obligations.article_or_task: ISO 42001 Art. 9.2 — AIMS Internal Audit
obligations.description: Schedule and perform periodic internal audits evaluating AIMS compliance with corporate governance standards.

obligations.article_or_task: GDPR Art. 22 — Explicit Profiling Consent
obligations.description: Set up clear data privacy consent notices obtaining explicit user sign-off for automated profile generation.

obligations.article_or_task: GDPR Art. 22.3 — Intervention Right
obligations.description: Provide an accessible mechanism letting customers challenge automated scoring and demand manual review.

obligations.article_or_task: GDPR Art. 35 — AIA / DPIA Masking Verification
obligations.description: Enforce and log strict PII redaction (masking emails, names, SSNs) before payload transfer to cloud LLMs.
